Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class AdminDealService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.AdminDealService
public class AdminDealService extends Object
Control class for Task 3.5 All Deals Record: the list with filters, VIEW DETAILS and CSV export. A deal is an accepted offer, in progress or completed; pending, countered and declined offers are not deals. Every method starts with the admin role check. This class does not use the ui layer.

  • Method Details

    • findDeals

      public List<DealRecord> findDeals(DealFilter filter)
      Lists the deals for the admin (Task 3.5 steps 2-3), newest start date first. Every chosen filter must match; a null filter field means "no filter".
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter options, or null for no filter
      Returns:
      the matching deals; empty if none match (A1), never null

    • getDealDetails

      public DealDetails getDealDetails(String offerId)
      The details of one deal for VIEW DETAILS (Task 3.5 step 4.1).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the offer does not exist or is not a deal (not accepted)

    • exportCsv

      public String exportCsv(List<DealRecord> deals)
      Exports deals as CSV text (Task 3.5 step 4.2), normally the currently filtered list. Every text field is escaped. No file is written; the screen saves the returned string.
